item.title: Demonstrating Real Time AV2 Decoding on Consumer Laptops
item.description:
📝 They showed real-time AV2 playback on laptops using current reference implementations, spanning both native applications and browser-based streaming pipelines. Web-based decoding and streaming pipeline A second demonstration showed AV2 decoding in a browser-based streaming environment. Technical observations Across both demonstrations, several technical observations emerged: AV2 decoding is already functional in real playback environments using reference implementations.
